name: The Wound in Cassiopeia
description: A slow gravitational maw drifting through the outer arm, bending starlight into perfect rings and dragging comets into orbits that should not survive. Charts mark it with a warning older than most spacefaring species: sail wide, or arrive as light.
observedEffects: starlight bends into perfect rings around empty space
probe trajectories decay without measurable cause
crew report phantom tides during close approaches
